title: Silas and the Ghost
author: Oscar Quintana
blurb: Vesper Sterling, a fixer for an embassy that doesn't officially exist, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. Then every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must burn the network that did the training, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
